stage1.impression: A moody, warm, competently lit bar render with good low-key exposure and believable terrazzo and back-bar glow, but it still reads as CG: the slatted oak and the lit band above it are clean and uniform like a light box, the motion-blurred figures look like translucent ghosts rather than people moving, and the half of the frame on the right is dead plaster. The EARF speaker is a tiny red patch deep inside the lantern, half hidden by the porch leaf, and the multicoloured ring object next to it is the frame's loudest colour, so the hero does not read at a glance. As it stands it is a generic slat-and-pendant hospitality render rather than a specific place a magazine would publish.

blocking_9: The Tropos speaker must read at a glance: region [565,445,605,530] lum_median >= 45 and its silhouette clear of the porch leaf
The amber band must read as thick cast acrylic fins with glowing edges, not a flat back-lit sign: band median about 70-100 instead of 133, with visible fin-to-fin modulation
The porch face must not be the brightest surface in the frame (now median 143, brighter than the speaker by 5x)
The figures must read as people in motion (opaque core, blurred edges), not see-through ghosts
The right third (dead plaster wall, median 19) must carry something: a pool of light, a texture, or be cropped out by the camera
Lived-in signs on the counter and banquette (a record out of its sleeve, a coat, a used napkin) so it reads as a specific, used room

defects.what: Lit acrylic band reads as a flat, evenly back-lit sign or corrugated plastic panel; median 133, uniform across its length (profile y bins 139-141), no fin edges or depth
Porch head is the hottest large surface in the frame (median 143, p95 200) from the band and the baffle graze, pulling the eye away from the speaker
Tropos speaker underexposed (median 28, p95 100 with 0.65% clip on one hot edge) and partly occluded by the right porch leaf
Multicoloured blue/green/yellow/red ring object is the most saturated element; competes with the Ember speaker and breaks one-colour rule
Seated figure motion blur is translucent: the slats show through the torso, reading as a ghost composite
Bartender is a transparent dark smear in front of the bottles
Right wall is a blank dark plane (median 19) with no plaster texture or light pool; dead area of about a fifth of the frame
Ceiling is a featureless black field (median 13) with pin-dot downlights; reads as a void
Oak slats are perfectly regular and clean, with no grain variation, oil sheen or tonal variation from board to board; reads as a CG pattern
Faint haze beam/streak above the porch from a downlight reads as a render artefact rather than atmosphere

changes.problem: The hero speaker is too dark to read and is outshone by the porch and the band.

change.setting: inside the lantern: the pair spot
change.to: 2 x 130 W, 20 deg, aimed at the speakers' faces

changes.expected: The Ember cabinet glows through its acrylic and reads as the warm red focal point down the axis; speaker median about 50-60.

changes.problem: The acrylic band reads as a flat back-lit sign rather than thick cast fins.

evidence.measured: lum_median 133.3, profile y bins flat at 139-141 across the middle; the brightest large area in the frame

change.to: 0.05, with a light from below (graze from the foot of the band) so the fins' polished edges catch light while their faces stay smoky

changes.expected: Band drops to a warm amber glow with visible fin-edge highlights against darker faces; reads as cast acrylic and no longer as signage.

changes.problem: The porch head is overexposed and is the brightest object in the room.
changes.expected: The porch reads as oak in a soft pool rather than a lit box; the eye travels through the porch to the speaker.

changes.problem: The speaker is half hidden by the porch leaf and the right fifth of the frame is dead wall.

evidence.measured: lum_median 19.2; speaker clipped by the leaf at x 600

change.to: move about 0.4 m toward +y (toward the lantern's axis) and look at [13.0, 3.9, 1.8], lens 35 mm

changes.expected: The speaker sits clear in the porch opening near the centre, the band and porch fill the upper middle, the blank right wall and black ceiling shrink.

changes.problem: The figures read as translucent ghosts, the clearest CG giveaway in the frame.

evidence.measured: slats visible through the seated torso; bartender at [20,430,110,540] the same

change.to: 0.35, with the figures' motion reduced to a hand or head movement so the body core is opaque and only the extremities blur

changes.expected: People read as guests caught moving in a long exposure; faces still lost to blur and shadow.

changes.problem: The right wall and banquette side are a dead dark plane with no pool of light.

evidence.measured: lum_median 19.2, falloff x from 13 to 56 only at the banquette back

change.to: 4 x 20 W, 30 deg, aimed to wash the lime plaster above the banquette in scallops

changes.expected: Pools of warm light on the plaster with dark between, showing its trowel texture; the right side joins the composition.

changes.problem: The oak slats are perfectly regular and clean, reading as a CG pattern.

evidence.measured: seen at 1:1: identical tone slat to slat, no grain or sheen variation

change.setting: the oak's tone (finish within its kind)
change.to: per-slat tone and grain variation of about +/-8%, a low oiled sheen (roughness 0.45-0.6) and slightly darker end grain at the cut tops

changes.expected: The baffle reads as real oiled oak boards at their real scale.

changes.problem: The room is staged and unused, so it reads as a generic bar rather than a specific lived-in place.

evidence.measured: seen: identical tumblers spaced evenly on counter and tables, nothing else

change.to: a record out of its sleeve leaning on the counter end, a sleeve on a table, a coat over the banquette, glasses at different fills and positions, a bar towel

changes.expected: Signs of life and of the bar's purpose (listening) at a glance.

out_of_scope.request: Mute or tint the multicoloured ring object inside the lantern so the Ember speaker is the only saturated colour
out_of_scope.why: EARF's products as placed and their tints are fixed by the card; only its spot level may change

out_of_scope.request: Change the band's fins to frosted or thicker acrylic
out_of_scope.why: The acrylic band's place and fins are fixed; only the emission and lighting may change
